key_idea: Directly test the four acceptance rules.
sketch: Accept if P == S, or |S| = |P|+1 and S is a digit followed by P, or P followed by a digit, or the case-swapped P equals S. O(n). Pitfalls: the prepended/appended character must be a digit and it is S that is longer, not P; case reversal swaps every letter, it is not a case-insensitive compare.
